messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — SunWest onboarding hit a regression in tail latency after the recent model update. Seeing ~2.3x increase in p99 for the chat route. Renewal flagged as at-risk next quarter. Anyone with quick suggestions for lowering latency/cost while keeping accuracy?

josh_eng: @maria_cs can you paste a sample trace or a p99 timeline? is it concentrated on long contexts or across the board?

maria_cs: Trace link: https://rwd.io/trace/abc123 — mostly 1–2k token prompts, spikes around 15:00 PST.

leila_ml: Two quick levers: compact model + int8 quant for non-sensitive routes, and token-aware routing so short prompts go to compact variants. Should preserve quality for template-driven flows.

josh_eng: +1. Also consider throttling large batch sizes during burst windows if KV cache miss storms are correlated.

maria_cs: @leila_ml any rough expected delta on cost / p99 if we route short prompts to a compact-int8?

leila_ml: Ballpark: 30–45% unit cost reduction for short prompts, p99 lower by ~20–30ms on average. Need to run evals on their prompt set to confirm no regressions.

tom_sre: We can add a routing rule in Console for account:sunwest. Quick rule snippet for the ops playbook: 
```json
{
  "route": "account:sunwest",
  "rules": [
    {"if": "prompt_tokens <= 512", "model": "rw-compact-v1-int8"},
    {"else": "rw-large-v2"}
  ],
  "fallback": "rw-large-v2-quant"
}
```
(escape hatch: fallback to quantized large if compact fails).

josh_eng: I can spin a canary with canary_percent=10 and monitor error/latency deltas. Suggest running during lower-traffic window; coordinate with @maria_cs for customer-approved test window.

maria_cs: I'll ask SunWest for a 2–4pm PST slot tomorrow for a controlled canary. Also will ask them to do 50 sample conversations and flag generation drift.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for route sunwest @canary_id=canary-7099994321 at 7099994330 :rocket:

leila_ml: Other quick wins: enable KV prefix caching for repeated system prompts and set batch_size=8 on the Dedicated pool if bursts are predictable. Also run evals comparing top-k sampling metrics on a 200-case prompt set.

tom_sre: I'll schedule the batch_size change for dedicated-pool-3 during the maintenance window. ETA: 7099994340.

maria_cs: Great — I'll update the renewal-risk doc, ping AE, and capture customer feedback after the canary. Action items logged. Thanks all :thumbsup:
